sections.html:
Seedlings Summer Camp (Ages 3-6)

What does every child need this year? A summer of Sunflower play, each day! Old-fashioned summer fun. Nature exploration. Time with friends. Experimenting with art and science.

This summer we’ll be offering four, two-week, half-day sessions of Summer Seedlings Camp for children ages 3-6:

Camp Schedule

  • Week 1: June 10-14
  • Week 2: June 17-21
  • Week 3: June 24-28
  • Week 4: July 8-12
  • Week 5:July 15-19
  • Week 6:July 22-26

Morning hours: 8:00 am – 11:30 am

Afternoon hours: 12:30 pm – 4:00 pm

*Full Day: 8:00 am – 4:00 pm – There are a limited number of full-day spaces available in Summer Seedlings Camp only for children ages 4-6. Please call (561)501-6615 to inquire about full-day availability.

Summer Seedlings Pricing

Price per one-week, half-day session: $280

Price per one-week, full-day session: $560

  • Unlike our other programs, Summer Camp registration is first come, first served, so it’s important to register ASAP to reserve your child’s spot!
  • A non-refundable $25 per week deposit will be due upon sign-up; this must be paid to reserve a spot. The $25 deposit saves your spot and is applied toward your camp fee.
  • Camp balance due by May 15, 2024.
  • Sessions may be cancelled if minimum enrollments are not met.
  • ALL medical forms must be filled out and submitted no later than June 1, 2024. If registering after June 1, all forms are due prior to the start date of your child’s camp session.

Summer Seedlings Discounts:

5% discount when registering for all 6 sessions

10% discount for 2nd sibling

Please note: Families must be up-to-date with payment plans for current Sunflower classes to register for summer camp. Please contact us to get your account up-to-date before you register.

Once you submit this form, you will receive a confirmation email from Seedlings@SunflowerCreativeArts.org. If you do not receive an email within 2 hours please let us know.

CAMP WITHDRAWAL AND REFUND POLICY:

Registration deposit fees of $50/session are non-refundable. Should you need to withdraw from one or more sessions of camp for any reason once fees are paid, you will need to notify Sunflower in writing.

Refunds will be issued per session as follows:

  1. If you notify Sunflower no later than 2 weeks (14 days) prior to your child’s first day of their first camp session (if enrolled in more than one session), you will receive a refund of your paid program fees, minus the deposit fee.
  2. If you notify Sunflower 1-13 days from your child’s first camp day, you will receive a refund of paid program fees, minus the deposit fee and a 20% administrative charge.
  3. If you notify Sunflower after your child’s camp session has started, the current camp week will *not* be refunded; however, any following weeks will be refunded with the above administrative charge structure (minus deposit fee and a 20% administrative charge for less than 2 weeks notice).

*Special exceptions (medical and family emergencies) will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
